propositions: Replace the grandfathering module-size allowlist with an absolute 800 LOC cap enforced in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml workflows, reading the limit from .github/module-size-limit.txt and rejecting any src/rebar file exceeding it.

Implement a limit-lock mechanism that fetches main's tip by explicit GitHub URL and fails with 'must override' if the limit file on main differs from the current change's limit, allowing only bootstrap (file introduced on this change) or unchanged values.
The gate must fail if .github/module-size-limit.txt is missing, and emit a warning (not silent failure) if the main-branch fetch fails, falling back to the absolute cap check.
Update test_module_size_contract.py to drop allowlist/ceilings assertions, read the cap from the limit file, and verify all src/rebar files respect it.
Update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to reference .github/module-size-limit.txt as a shared gate signature instead of the allowlist/ceilings files.
Retain the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files in this change so main's current gate continues to pass CI; Phase 2b will delete them after this gate is live.
